description: base has a single fused addmm node; head expresses the same math as separate mm then add.
note: A fused op (addmm = add(n0, mm(n1, n2))) in base is decomposed into mm + add in head. Modeled as remove(fused) + add(constituents) because no single base node aligns to a single head node. Simplified representation: real fusion happens in the Inductor pass, but at the FX node level this captures the structural shape the diff must report.
